A '''Nightsister''' lived on [[Dathomir]]. [[Gender|She]] was [[Death|killed]] during the [[Battle of Dathomir]]<ref name="V+V" /> in [[20 BBY]],<ref name="SWGA" /> becoming a spirit.<ref name="V+V" /> When [[Maul]] and [[Jedi]] [[Padawan]] [[Ezra Bridger]] drank a [[Merging potion|potion]] to restart their [[Force-bond/Legends|force bond]], the spell woke up a group of [[Nightsisters|Nightsister]] spirits. She told the group to pay their dues of flesh and blood. The sister then [[Possession|possessed]] [[Kanan Jarrus]], [[Skirmish on Dathomir|engaging]] into [[Lightsaber combat|duel]] with Maul. Ezra and Maul ran out the [[Nightsister fortress]]. The spirit refused to go outside the structure, as their energy was drawn from the [[Nightsisters' altar]]. When Ezra entered the building, the spirit engaged in combat with Ezra. Overpowering Ezra, Ezra [[Force push|pushed]] the spirit in order to gain the upper hand. The padawan told the spirit that he was the one the spirit wanted, causing the spirit to leave Kanan's body. The spirit charged at Ezra, but Ezra destroyed the Nightsister altar, causing the spirit to disenegrate.<ref name="V+V" />
